verses.ar: لِلْإِنْسَانِ تَدَابِيرُ ٱلْقَلْبِ، وَمِنَ ٱلرَّبِّ جَوَابُ ٱللِّسَانِ.
verses.kjv: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, [is] from the LORD.
verses.web: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.

verses.ar: كُلُّ طُرُقِ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ نَقِيَّةٌ فِي عَيْنَيْ نَفْسِهِ، وَٱلرَّبُّ وَازِنُ ٱلْأَرْوَاحِ.
verses.kjv: All the ways of a man [are] clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.
verses.web: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the motives.

verses.ar: أَلْقِ عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ أَعْمَالَكَ فَتُثَبَّتَ أَفْكَارُكَ.
verses.kjv: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
verses.web: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.

verses.ar: اَلرَّبُّ صَنَعَ ٱلْكُلَّ لِغَرَضِهِ، وَٱلشِّرِّيرَ أَيْضًا لِيَوْمِ ٱلشَّرِّ.
verses.kjv: The LORD hath made all [things] for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.web: Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

verses.ar: مَكْرَهَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ كُلُّ مُتَشَامِخِ ٱلْقَلْبِ. يَدًا لِيَدٍ لَا يَتَبَرَّأُ.
verses.kjv: Every one [that is] proud in heart [is] an abomination to the LORD: [though] hand [join] in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
verses.web: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh; they shall certainly not be unpunished.

verses.ar: بِٱلرَّحْمَةِ وَٱلْحَقِّ يُسْتَرُ ٱلْإِثْمُ، وَفِي مَخَافَةِ ٱلرَّبِّ ٱلْحَيَدَانُ عَنِ ٱلشَّرِّ.
verses.kjv: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD [men] depart from evil.
verses.web: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.

verses.ar: إِذَا أَرْضَتِ ٱلرَّبَّ طُرُقُ إِنْسَانٍ، جَعَلَ أَعْدَاءَهُ أَيْضًا يُسَالِمُونَهُ.
verses.kjv: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.web: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

verses.ar: اَلْقَلِيلُ مَعَ ٱلْعَدْلِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ دَخْلٍ جَزِيلٍ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ.
verses.kjv: Better [is] a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
verses.web: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.

verses.ar: قَلْبُ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ يُفَكِّرُ فِي طَرِيقِهِ، وَٱلرَّبُّ يَهْدِي خَطْوَتَهُ.
verses.kjv: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
verses.web: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.

verses.ar: فِي شَفَتَيِ ٱلْمَلِكِ وَحْيٌ. فِي ٱلْقَضَاءِ فَمُهُ لَا يَخُونُ.
verses.kjv: A divine sentence [is] in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
verses.web: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.

verses.ar: قَبَّانُ ٱلْحَقِّ وَمَوَازِينُهُ لِلرَّبِّ. كُلُّ مَعَايِيرِ ٱلْكِيسِ عَمَلُهُ.
verses.kjv: A just weight and balance [are] the LORD’s: all the weights of the bag [are] his work.
verses.web: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.

verses.ar: مَكْرَهَةُ ٱلْمُلُوكِ فِعْلُ ٱلشَّرِّ، لِأَنَّ ٱلْكُرْسِيَّ يُثَبَّتُ بِٱلْبِرِّ.
verses.kjv: [It is] an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.web: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.

verses.ar: مَرْضَاةُ ٱلْمُلُوكِ شَفَتَا حَقٍّ، وَٱلْمُتَكَلِّمُ بِٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَاتِ يُحَبُّ.
verses.kjv: Righteous lips [are] the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
verses.web: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.

verses.ar: غَضَبُ ٱلْمَلِكِ رُسُلُ ٱلْمَوْتِ، وَٱلْإِنْسَانُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ يَسْتَعْطِفُهُ.
verses.kjv: The wrath of a king [is as] messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
verses.web: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.

verses.ar: فِي نُورِ وَجْهِ ٱلْمَلِكِ حَيَاةٌ، وَرِضَاهُ كَسَحَابِ ٱلْمَطَرِ ٱلْمُتَأَخِّرِ.
verses.kjv: In the light of the king’s countenance [is] life; and his favour [is] as a cloud of the latter rain.
verses.web: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.

verses.ar: قِنْيَةُ ٱلْحِكْمَةِ كَمْ هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ، وَقِنْيَةُ ٱلْفَهْمِ تُخْتَارُ عَلَى ٱلْفِضَّةِ!
verses.kjv: How much better [is it] to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
verses.web: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

verses.ar: مَنْهَجُ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِينَ ٱلْحَيَدَانُ عَنِ ٱلشَّرِّ. حَافِظٌ نَفْسَهُ حَافِظٌ طَرِيقَهُ.
verses.kjv: The highway of the upright [is] to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
verses.web: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

verses.ar: قَبْلَ ٱلْكَسْرِ ٱلْكِبْرِيَاءُ، وَقَبْلَ ٱلسُّقُوطِ تَشَامُخُ ٱلرُّوحِ.
verses.kjv: Pride [goeth] before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.web: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

verses.ar: تَوَاضُعُ ٱلرُّوحِ مَعَ ٱلْوُدَعَاءِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ قَسْمِ ٱلْغَنِيمَةِ مَعَ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ.
verses.kjv: Better [it is to be] of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
verses.web: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.

verses.ar: ٱلْفَطِنُ مِنْ جِهَةِ أَمْرٍ يَجِدُ خَيْرًا، وَمَنْ يَتَّكِلُ عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ فَطُوبَى لَهُ.
verses.kjv: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy [is] he.
verses.web: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.

verses.ar: حَكِيمُ ٱلْقَلْبِ يُدْعَى فَهِيمًا، وَحَلَاوَةُ ٱلشَّفَتَيْنِ تَزِيدُ عِلْمًا.
verses.kjv: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
verses.web: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

verses.ar: ٱلْفِطْنَةُ يَنْبُوعُ حَيَاةٍ لِصَاحِبِهَا، وَتَأْدِيبُ ٱلْحَمْقَى حَمَاقَةٌ.
verses.kjv: Understanding [is] a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools [is] folly.
verses.web: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.

verses.ar: قَلْبُ ٱلْحَكِيمِ يُرْشِدُ فَمَهُ وَيَزِيدُ شَفَتَيْهِ عِلْمًا.
verses.kjv: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
verses.web: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.

verses.ar: اَلْكَلَامُ ٱلْحَسَنُ شَهْدُ عَسَلٍ، حُلْوٌ لِلنَّفْسِ وَشِفَاءٌ لِلْعِظَامِ.
verses.kjv: Pleasant words [are as] an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.web: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

verses.ar: تُوجَدُ طَرِيقٌ تَظْهَرُ لِلْإِنْسَانِ مُسْتَقِيمَةً وَعَاقِبَتُهَا طُرُقُ ٱلْمَوْتِ.
verses.kjv: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof [are] the ways of death.
verses.web: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

verses.ar: نَفْسُ ٱلتَّعِبِ تُتْعِبُ لَهُ، لِأَنَّ فَمَهُ يَحِثُّهُ.
verses.kjv: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
verses.web: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّجُلُ ٱللَّئِيمُ يَنْبُشُ ٱلشَّرَّ، وَعَلَى شَفَتَيْهِ كَٱلنَّارِ ٱلْمُتَّقِدَةِ.
verses.kjv: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips [there is] as a burning fire.
verses.web: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.

verses.ar: رَجُلُ ٱلْأَكَاذِيبِ يُطْلِقُ ٱلْخُصُومَةَ، وَٱلنَّمَّامُ يُفَرِّقُ ٱلْأَصْدِقَاءَ.
verses.kjv: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
verses.web: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.

verses.ar: اَلرَّجُلُ ٱلظَّالِمُ يُغْوِي صَاحِبَهُ وَيَسُوقُهُ إِلَى طَرِيقٍ غَيْرِ صَالِحَةٍ.
verses.kjv: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way [that is] not good.
verses.web: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.

verses.ar: مَنْ يُغَمِّضُ عَيْنَيْهِ لِيُفَكِّرَ فِي ٱلْأَكَاذِيبِ، وَمَنْ يَعَضُّ شَفَتَيْهِ، فَقَدْ أَكْمَلَ شَرًّا.
verses.kjv: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
verses.web: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

verses.ar: تَاجُ جَمَالٍ: شَيْبَةٌ تُوجَدُ فِي طَرِيقِ ٱلْبِرِّ.
verses.kjv: The hoary head [is] a crown of glory, [if] it be found in the way of righteousness.
verses.web: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

verses.ar: اَلْبَطِيءُ ٱلْغَضَبِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ ٱلْجَبَّارِ، وَمَالِكُ رُوحِهِ خَيْرٌ مِمَّنْ يَأْخُذُ مَدِينَةً.
verses.kjv: [He that is] slow to anger [is] better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
verses.web: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

verses.ar: ٱلْقُرْعَةُ تُلْقَى فِي ٱلْحِضْنِ، وَمِنَ ٱلرَّبِّ كُلُّ حُكْمِهَا.
verses.kjv: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof [is] of the LORD.
verses.web: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.
